proof_simplifications: Chain rule: substitute Markov factorization and distribute square root.
Monotonicity: sum prefix-overlap recurrence against sub-stochastic row masses.
DP correctness: downward induction follows the already-derived recurrence; terminal map follows from the per-pixel theorem.
Per-pixel theorem: group squared-root differences by terminal fibre; no repeated nested-sum expansions.
Survival theorem: one-step conditioning, telescoping Doob factors, Bayes rule, and existing chain/per-pixel results.
Randomization: one-step ordinary-overlap contraction iterated across affected layers, with explicit hypotheses.
precision_repairs: Alive/dead mismatch only annihilates full overlap if the alive row has no cemetery leakage.
Per-pixel zero-contribution condition explicitly includes two zero terminal masses; strict conditional-law comparison requires both terminal masses positive.
Ordinary-state disagreement is not obtained by merely rescaling its total into a conditioned Hellinger map.

precision_repairs.issue: Original conditional probability at unreachable states was undefined as an event-conditioned ratio.
precision_repairs.resolution: Interpret survival probability through the transition kernel started at the state, including unreachable states.

precision_repairs.issue: Original Doob law product was asserted over all surviving paths although kernel rows only defined for positive survival.
precision_repairs.resolution: Complete zero-survival rows arbitrarily as probability distributions; they are unreachable under the conditioned law.

precision_repairs.issue: Original conditioned geometric kernel ratio lacked a positive-denominator qualification.
precision_repairs.resolution: State the ratio only on jointly positive survival rows; entrywise geometric mean of completed kernels remains defined elsewhere.

precision_repairs: CNN/Transformer randomization reduction explicitly requires the same stated hypotheses; indicator-weighted survival distance is zero off its positive-survival event.
